messages.text:
"Create a 3D action/destruction simulator game.
The player controls a massive, futuristic space satellite orbiting planet Earth.
The camera is positioned behind the satellite, looking down at the 3D Earth, which slowly rotates below.
Controls:
• Movement: The satellite moves in orbit around Earth (left/right/up/down) using WASD keys or mouse movement.
• Attack: Holding Left Mouse Button (LMB) fires a superpowerful, thick, bright-yellow laser beam from the center of the satellite directly onto the surface of the Earth.
Destruction Effects:
• Visuals: At the laser's impact point on the Earth's surface, there should be explosions, sparks, and a glowing, molten, fiery trail left behind (using decals or a scorched-earth shader).
• Environment: Continents and glowing city lights should be visible on the planet.
Game Logic @COMMENT_BODY@ UI:
• Objective: The player's goal is to burn 100% of the Earth's surface.
• UI: Add an on-screen counter that displays: \"Earth destroyed: X%\".
"
